$comment: Fortification Point types (design doc §9.4). Three numbers per type: Point HP, Structural DEF (used when the structure itself is the target), Defender DEF Bonus (granted to the Presented unit once it qualifies as Defender by occupancy).

types.name: Stone (old Roman-era masonry)
types.notes: Rare at 825; typically inherited or captured rather than built.

makeshift.note: Improvised or natural version of the base type. Makeshift Wooden: HP 48 / DEF 7 / +6. Makeshift Stone: HP 90 / DEF 12 / +12.
